snippet.title: IREM Collection Volume 3 - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
We are excited to reveal the titles of the IREM Collection Vol. 3! This collection continues to celebrate the gaming legacy of IREM, one of the industry's most esteemed pioneers 
👉 https://www.iningames.com/games/irem-collection-vol-3

This volume is packed with true arcade gems of the shoot 'em-up genre: Mr. Heli, Mystic Riders, and Dragon Breed. It’s coming in 2024, and if you are a collector, you can already snag exclusive Limited Editions (Playstation & Switch) starting on October 12 on Strictly Limited Games! 

What more to expect:
- Three fantastic arcade-era IREM standard shoot ‘em ups.
- A quick save and load feature to guarantee your progress.
- Built-in filters to relive the original game experience.
- New integrated help functions, such as rewind and fast-forward features.
- Worldwide leaderboards to put your score on display.
- Many fantastic stages with bizarre enemies and enormous boss fights.
